doctrine.title: Lean Project Controls Doctrine
doctrine.summary: Preserve the baseline, status one current forecast, and test recovery separately.
principles: Public fact and assessment simulation are explicitly separated.
Baseline → Actual Progress → Recovery is the reviewer-facing schedule governance chain.
No manpower hours, wage rates or productivity data are fabricated.
Recovery remains conditional on Construction, Engineering, Procurement, QA/QC, HSE and Commercial validation.
Forecast difference is not automatically contractual delay or entitlement.

documentControl.controlNote: Public project facts anchor the case; detailed control logic remains assessment-derived.

assessmentBoundary.public: October-2025 start month, 30-month published period, public package value, 4.19% progress at 05-May-2026, July-2028 current completion target.
assessmentBoundary.illustrative: Exact model start day, 49-activity schedule logic, task-level status allocation, BOQ/control budget, remaining-duration placement and recovery actions.
assessmentBoundary.confidentiality: No Kubota Construction confidential programme, BOQ, rates, claims, tender information or internal procedures are represented.
